shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | head -100
cat /workspace/package.json

for f in /workspace/next.config.ts /workspace/tsconfig.json /workspace/lib/products.ts /workspace/app/layout.tsx /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx /workspace/app/ProductSkeleton.tsx /workspace/app/globals.css "/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo "=== git log ==="; git log --oneline -5 && git diff --stat
node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" 2>&1; node -e "console.log(require('react/package.json').version)" 2>&1; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled | grep -i react
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -20; echo "--- shared ---"; grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "ViewTransition\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head; echo "=== schema ==="; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== all occurrences count ==="; grep -rl "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js | head -30

git diff package.json; echo "=== react exports ==="; node -e "const R=require('react'); console.log(Object.keys(R).filter(k=>/View|unstable|experimental/i.test(k)))"; echo "=== next peerDeps ==="; node -e "const p=require('next/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies))"

sed -n '160,200p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts; echo "=== compiled react-experimental exports ==="; node -e "const R=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental'); console.log(Object.keys(R).filter(k=>/View/i.test(k)))"; echo "=== compiled react (stable vendored) ==="; node -e "const R=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log(Object.keys(R).filter(k=>/View/i.test(k)))"

cd /workspace; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config*.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== any non-compiled dist refs ==="; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js --include=*.d.ts -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/compiled/" | grep -v bundle-analyzer | head

cd /workspace; node -e "console.log(require('@types/react/package.json').version)"; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head; echo "=== canary types? ==="; ls node_modules/@types/react/
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

cd /workspace; grep -rn "compiled/react'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -20; echo "=== createRSCAliases / getReactAliases ==="; grep -rn "react\$" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -30
cd /workspace; grep -rn "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/compiled/" | grep -v bundle-analyzer | head -20

cd /workspace; sed -n '60,110p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/sequential-router-queue.js; echo "=== where types come from ==="; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client --include=*.js | grep -v esm | head -20

cd /workspace; grep -rn "compiled/react" node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== turbopack ==="; grep -rn "compiled/react\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/turbopack-build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/build/ | grep -i alias
cd /workspace; ls node_modules/.bin/next && node -e "console.log(process.version)"; ls -d node_modules/react node_modules/react-dom 2>&1

cd /workspace; node -e "const p=require('@types/react/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports?.['./canary']||p.typesVersions, null, 2))"; echo "=== next/link.d.ts ==="; cat node_modules/next/link.d.ts

cd /workspace; echo "=== react-server export ==="; node -e "const R=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/react.react-server.js'); console.log(Object.keys(R).filter(k=>/View/i.test(k)))" 2>&1; echo "=== flight server support ==="; grep -c "REACT_VIEW_TRANSITION_TYPE" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.production.js 2>&1; grep -o "view_transition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.production.js | head -3
cd /workspace; grep -n "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<div class="product-grid">.\{0,400\}'; echo; echo "=== DETAIL ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3123/product/wireless-headphones | grep -o '<div class="product-detail">.\{0,500\}'
cd /workspace; ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer" ; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; echo "exit:$?"

cd /workspace; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'class="product-grid"[^>]*' ; echo "--- thumbnails ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'class="product-image"[^>]*' ; echo "--- main/page wrapper ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<main[^>]*'

cd /workspace; grep -o 'vt-enter[^"]\{0,40\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.production.js | head -5; echo "=== which vt-* attrs are emitted server-side ==="; grep -o '"vt-[a-z]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.production.js | sort -u; echo "=== client-side vt-* ==="; grep -o '"vt-[a-z]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js | sort -u
cd /workspace; grep -o '.\{700\}vt-enter.\{700\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js | head -1

cd /workspace; grep -o 'function getViewTransitionClassName.\{0,600\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -1; echo "=== per-type resolver ==="; grep -o 'function getClassNameByType.\{0,400\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -1
cd /workspace; grep -o 'function getClassNameByType(classByType) {.\{0,700\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -1
cd /workspace; grep -n "function getClassNameByType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js

cd /workspace; grep -n "function applyViewTransitionName\|function restoreViewTransitionName\|shouldStartViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head
cd /workspace; grep -n 'applyViewTransitionToHostInstances(' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -20
cd /tmp && timeout 25 npm view playwright version 2>&1 | tail -3
mkdir -p /tmp/vtcheck && cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 300 npm i playwright@1.62.1 --silent --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "install exit: $?"
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 420 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "exit: $?"
ls /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3123/ 2>&1; echo " <- server status"
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 180 node verify.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 180 node verify.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
id -u; which apt-get dnf yum microdnf apk 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -4; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -2

sudo -n id 2>&1 | head -2; echo "---"; timeout 200 sudo -n dnf install -y nspr nss alsa-lib at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr libxkbcommon pango mesa-libgbm 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 180 node verify.mjs 2>&1 | tail -50
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 180 node shots.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20; ls -la /tmp/vtcheck/*.png
cd /tmp/vtcheck && timeout 120 node probe.mjs 2>&1 | tail -50
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; grep -n "next-env\|.next" .gitignore
cd /workspace; echo "--- .gitignore ---"; cat .gitignore; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"

cd /workspace; pgrep -f "next-server|next start" >/dev/null && echo "STILL RUNNING" || echo "server down"; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && echo "artifacts removed"
cd /workspace; pkill -9 -f next-server; pkill -9 -f "next start"; sleep 1; pgrep -f "next-server|next start" >/dev/null && echo "STILL RUNNING" || echo "server down"; exit 0
cd /workspace; pgrep -af "next-server|next start" || echo "server down"; exit 0
cd /workspace; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
npx next build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; tail -3 /tmp/build2.log; (npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 7; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3124/
cd /workspace; pkill -9 -f next-server >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 1; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git checkout tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; git status --short; exit 0
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "--- artifacts present? ---"; ls -d .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>&1 | head; exit 0
cd /workspace; pgrep -af 'nex[t]-server' || echo "no server running"; exit 0
cd /workspace; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git checkout tsconfig.json; git status --short
cd /workspace; git diff -- app/ | head -120
